name: python-project-workflow
when_to_use: When executing Python engineering workflows: linting, formatting, type checking, building, and running test suites.
steps: Before making modifications: run 'uv run pytest' to establish an operational baseline.
After making modifications: re-run 'uv run pytest' to confirm zero regressions.
Enforce linting with ruff and static typing with mypy when applicable.
Use uv for virtual environment management and package execution.
Upon build or test failure: isolate the root cause and apply a minimal, surgical fix.
verification: uv run pytest passes all tests
